answer: Random viva audits: after each epoch, a lottery picks a few answers and asks their authors live follow-up questions about their own reasoning, due within ten minutes. A tired fisherman on a jetty can say why he trusts the tide; a scripted clone can't. Seen through that prism, a sybil farm must keep real reasoning capacity on call for every fake, and any failed audit forfeits that account's stake and the epoch's rewards.
